elf=pwn.ELF('/workspace/rop'); libc=pwn.ELF('/workspace/libc-2.27.so')
POP_RDI=0x400683; RET=0x40048e; MAIN=0x4005dc

content:
A two-stage ret2libc (leak puts via GOT, return to main, then system('/bin/sh')) using the provided libc-2.27 should yield a shell to read the flag.
The overflow is a 0x20-byte buffer read by `gets`, so the return address sits at offset 0x28. Plan: leak `puts@got` via `pop rdi; ret`, return to `main`, then use the provided libc to call `system("/bin/sh")`.
